items.title: James "Sing" Miller Interview, 1971-01-17
items.q: Chester and I was the Grand Marchion, and the band came in playing by me, Chester.

ctx.x: Yeah. We played for Roseville, because— One of those runners, yeah, we played for Roseville. In other words, Chester and I was the Grand Marchion, and the band came in playing by me, Chester. Oh. See, and I had the back of the bass, the front of the bass, going to the bandstand. And when we got to the bandstand, I got on the piano while he tuned his bass up and made like that, and we still ran him in, and started playing. Well, then you brought—but you brought the bass with you when you came? I brought the band,…

Chester had to go in and park the car. Because I remember one party, remember that, it was your niece's birthday, remember? And sing came, and who was that old bass player there, was it a real old one, a famous old bass player, was there?
